svg.title: 03 build arm
svg.desc: Editable native text and vector geometry, transparent background. No embedded raster artwork.

text.inkscape:label: Text: 3

text.data-source-text: Build the rest of the arm on top
text.inkscape:label: Text: Build the rest of the arm on top
text.tspan: Build the rest of the arm on top

text.data-source-text: Build from the base rotor toward the tool. Intermediate rotors, hinges and pistons can keep their ordinary names.
text.inkscape:label: Text: Build from the base rotor toward the tool. Intermediate rotors, hinges
text.tspan: Build from the base rotor toward the tool. Intermediate rotors, hinges
and pistons can keep their ordinary names.

text.data-source-text: The example, from bottom to top, is:
text.inkscape:label: Text: The example, from bottom to top, is:
text.tspan: The example, from bottom to top, is:

text.inkscape:label: Text: 1.
Text: Base rotor.
text.tspan: Base rotor.

text.inkscape:label: Text: 2.
Text: A crossbar.
text.tspan: A crossbar.

text.inkscape:label: Text: 3.

text.data-source-text: Two hinges, one on each end of the crossbar, with a shared rotation axis.
text.inkscape:label: Text: Two hinges, one on each end of the crossbar, with a shared rotation ax
text.tspan: Two hinges, one on each end of the crossbar, with a shared
rotation axis.

text.inkscape:label: Text: 4.

text.data-source-text: Two pistons, one above each hinge.
text.inkscape:label: Text: Two pistons, one above each hinge.
text.tspan: Two pistons, one above each hinge.

text.inkscape:label: Text: 5.

text.data-source-text: A second crossbar, joining the piston heads.
text.inkscape:label: Text: A second crossbar, joining the piston heads.
text.tspan: A second crossbar, joining the piston heads.

text.inkscape:label: Text: 6.

text.data-source-text: A single hinge in the middle of the upper crossbar.
text.inkscape:label: Text: A single hinge in the middle of the upper crossbar.
text.tspan: A single hinge in the middle of the upper crossbar.

text.inkscape:label: Text: 7.

text.data-source-text: Rotor → hinge → piston → rotor → hinge → hinge → rotor → drill head.
text.inkscape:label: Text: Rotor → hinge → piston → rotor → hinge → hinge → rotor → drill head.
text.tspan: Rotor → hinge → piston → rotor → hinge → hinge → rotor → drill
head.

svg.title: Unsupported: misaligned parallel stages
svg.desc: The right hinge and piston stage starts one block above the left. The hinge axes do not line up.

text.inkscape:label: Text: Hydraulic structures:
text.tspan: Hydraulic structures:

text.data-source-text: A piston used as a brace to drive a hinged linkage is not supported.
text.inkscape:label: Text: A piston used as a brace to drive a hinged linkage is not supported.
text.tspan: A piston used as a brace to drive a
hinged linkage is not supported.

svg.title: Unsupported: hydraulic linkage
svg.desc: A diagonal piston braces the grid to a hinged boom and drives its rotation. This hydraulic-style structure is not supported.
